WITH matched_fees AS (
  SELECT o.mktnote, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net_fee_rate
  FROM fees AS f
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.recordvault = f.orderslink
), pair_averages AS (
  SELECT mktnote, AVG(net_fee_rate) AS avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM matched_fees
  GROUP BY mktnote
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(net_fee_rate) AS avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM matched_fees
), above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT p.avg_net_fee_rate, b.avg_net_fee_rate AS benchmark_rate
  FROM pair_averages AS p
  CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
  WHERE b.avg_net_fee_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND p.avg_net_fee_rate > b.avg_net_fee_rate
)
SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) AS average_pair_net_fee_rate,
       AVG(avg_net_fee_rate - benchmark_rate) AS average_excess_over_benchmark
FROM above_benchmark;
